# Test data with known truth

Synthetic multi-direction data sets, generated by `anisa testdata testdata` (2 % noise, seed 0).
Open a `*_start.anisa.json` in the GUI (File → Open project…) and press **Fit**: the fit should
return to the values in `TRUTH.txt` with χ²/N ≈ 1. The `NAME.anisa.json` file is the truth
itself. Each folder holds six NXcanSAS files (one per direction of Q; the angles are in the
project file, not in the data files).

| Folder | System |
|---|---|
| `prolate` | needles, aspect 7, mild alignment along the normal |
| `oblate` | platelets, aspect 1/6.7, mild alignment along the normal |
| `prolate_oblate` | strongly aligned needles + weakly aligned platelets |
| `interference` | dense prolate population with interference |
| `spheres` | isotropic polydisperse spheres |
| `many` | the `prolate_oblate` system along 12 directions |
